question: What is the extent and nature of the supreme pervading placement on the body?
premises: The range extends from head to foot.
The placement is described as pervading.
The placement is described as supreme.
inference: One should perform a supreme pervading placement extending from the head to the feet.
uncertainties: The token uttam appears truncated in form but is taken as uttamam in sense.
plain_english: One should place the supreme pervading element from the head down to the feet.
